Failure mode: Customer can access another customer's order/account data
Impact rationale: Unauthorised exposure of protected customer data
Likelihood rationale: Requires an authorization control defect but is a credible boundary failure
Primary treatment: Authorization API matrix plus security review

Failure mode: Legitimate customer cannot establish or maintain a valid session
Likelihood rationale: Session creation expiry and sign-out are common state transitions
Primary treatment: Auth API plus session lifecycle and focused UI checks

Failure mode: Catalogue presents stale or incorrect price/availability
Impact rationale: Incorrect commercial state can cause dispute or checkout failure
Likelihood rationale: Catalogue state changes and crosses service boundaries

Failure mode: Search/filter/sort returns incorrect or incomplete results
Impact rationale: Material discovery degradation without direct transaction corruption
Likelihood rationale: Search permutations and changing data create plausible defects

Failure mode: Search latency degrades under expected peak demand
Likelihood rationale: Peak demand and query complexity can expose degradation

Impact rationale: Customer can see or pay an incorrect amount
Likelihood rationale: Deterministic rules can fail at boundary/rule combinations

Failure mode: Basket state is lost or corrupted before checkout
Impact rationale: Customer cannot reliably continue prepared purchase
Likelihood rationale: Persistence navigation and concurrent state transitions create exposure
Primary treatment: API state transitions plus integration and focused E2E

Failure mode: Payment succeeds but ShopSphere does not create a durable order
Impact rationale: Financial and durable purchase state disagree
Likelihood rationale: Payment persistence and failure boundaries are plausible distributed-system risks
Primary treatment: Payment/order integration reconciliation observability and focused E2E

Failure mode: Retry after uncertain provider result creates a duplicate charge
Impact rationale: Customer can be charged more than once
Likelihood rationale: Timeout and retry are plausible distributed-system conditions
Primary treatment: Timeout simulation idempotency and repeated-request checks

Failure mode: Checkout is unavailable or too slow under peak demand
Impact rationale: Revenue-critical purchases can be broadly blocked
Likelihood rationale: Peak load dependency saturation and contention are plausible

Failure mode: Declined payment is reported as successful or ambiguously
Impact rationale: Customer/order state can misrepresent financial outcome
Likelihood rationale: Requires incorrect provider-response mapping at integration boundary
Primary treatment: Provider response mapping plus negative API/E2E

Failure mode: Same successful checkout creates more than one order
Impact rationale: Duplicate durable orders can trigger duplicate fulfilment
Likelihood rationale: Retries concurrency and eventual consistency expose missing idempotency
Primary treatment: Order idempotency concurrency and retry integration tests

Failure mode: Order is stored but not visible to owning customer
Impact rationale: Purchase status becomes unclear and support burden rises
Likelihood rationale: Requires persistence read-model or authorization inconsistency
Primary treatment: Persistence/read-model integration plus focused order-history E2E

Failure mode: Duplicate order-created event causes repeated downstream processing
Impact rationale: Duplicate downstream effects create operational/customer impact
Likelihood rationale: Duplicate delivery is plausible but idempotent consumers constrain exposure

Failure mode: Confirmation notification is delayed or missing
Impact rationale: Communication degrades while valid order remains durable
Likelihood rationale: Asynchronous delivery and retry make delay/failure plausible
